headline: 钱斯·萨尔茨曼交卸美国太空军太空作战部长职务
summary: 9月3日，Schiess在交接仪式上接任太空作战部长，接替Saltzman。报道另提到8月举行退休仪式；本条记录军种首长交接日。其他现职未查清，本次检索未发现具体新任命。

sources.title: Schiess installed as Space Force’s highest-ranking officer
sources.excerpt: Schiess succeeded Gen. Chance Saltzman as the third chief of space operations of the Space Force.

sources.title: CSO Schiess change of responsibility
sources.excerpt: Chief of Space Operations Gen. Douglas Schiess speaks during his change of responsibility ceremony on Joint Base Andrews, Md., Sept. 3, 2026. Schiess succeeded Gen. Chance Saltzman as the third CSO of the U.S. Space Force.
